nodes.label: Community Folk Healthcare
nodes.evidence_status: Healer, midwife, bone-setting, wells, remedies, vaccination, dispensary, and asylum claims are fact-checked; exact child-mortality percentage is unverified.
nodes.rationale: Wise people, hereditary bone-setters, midwives, herbs, charms, prayer, and holy wells formed the accessible and trusted health system for the rural poor.

nodes.label: Disease of Poverty System
nodes.rationale: Typhus, dysentery, consumption, smallpox, childhood disease, childbirth risk, overcrowding, and contaminated water link health directly to canonical household conditions.
